summary: Create expiring typed plans and rehearse incident actions against synthetic local fixtures only.
limitations: Only synthetic local JSON fixture actions are executable; production integrations are unavailable.
Approver identity and plan hash are self-recorded assertions, not approval attestation or immutable provenance.
Concurrent mutation by untrusted local accounts is not supported; use private staging.
Host installation and live incident response behavior have not been verified.

demo.description: Exercise fresh-clock plan, dry-run, execution, replay and expiry rejection, and rollback against disposable synthetic state.
